# Convert a title into a lowercase, hyphen-separated URL slug.
def slugify(title)
  title.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, '-').gsub(/\A-+|-+\z/, '')
end

if $PROGRAM_NAME == __FILE__
  require 'minitest/autorun'

  class SlugifyTest < Minitest::Test
    def test_slugifies_a_title
      assert_equal 'hello-world', slugify('Hello, World!')
    end

    def test_removes_leading_and_trailing_separators
      assert_equal 'ruby-123', slugify(' -- Ruby 123 -- ')
    end
  end
end
